diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3 V, datasheet reading 4.75 V
diffs.evidence: The two readings describe different rails. The part's top-level vmin/vmax (3-5.25 V) is the logic supply on board pin VDD = chip VCC_IO: TMC2209 datasheet, Operational Range table: 'I/O supply voltage VVIO 3.00 5.25 V'. The second reading's 4.75 V (with vmax 28 V) is the motor supply VS from the feature list 'Voltage Range 4.75... 28V DC'. The model already gives the motor pin VM its own range of 5.5-28 V, from the same table: 'Supply voltage (using internal +5V regulator) VVS 5.5 28 V'. The 4.75 V headline only covers the bridged case ('internal +5V regulator bridged: V5VOUT=VVS, VVS 4.7 5.4 V'), and the BTT V1.2 board is not wired that way. So the logic pin works from 3.0 V (3.3 V MCU), and the model's VM minimum of 5.5 V is the safer, correct figure for this board.
